title: Three-Chamber Social Preference Test in Mice
author: Sarah van Veen

steps.title: Perform Habituation Trial
steps.instruction: Habituate the test mouse to the novel environment by confining it to the central chamber of the empty apparatus for 5 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Place the test mouse in the central chamber.
Ensure side chambers are not accessible.

steps.title: Conduct Social Preference Trial
steps.instruction: Assess the mouse's preference for a social stimulus over an empty chamber over a 10-minute period.

substeps.instruction: Gently introduce an unfamiliar stranger mouse (S1) into one side chamber without handling the test mouse.
Leave the opposing side chamber empty (E), randomizing the position of S1 (left or right) across animals.
Open access to all three chambers and allow free exploration for 10 min.
Record time spent in the sniffing zone adjacent to S1 and the sniffing zone adjacent to the empty chamber using ANY-maze.

steps.title: Conduct Social Novelty Trial
steps.instruction: Assess the mouse's preference for a novel stranger over a familiar stranger over a 10-minute period.

substeps.instruction: Without removing the test mouse, introduce a second unfamiliar stranger mouse (S2) into the previously empty side chamber.
Record time spent in the sniffing zone adjacent to S1 (now familiar) and the sniffing zone adjacent to S2 (novel stranger) using ANY-maze.

steps.title: Clean Apparatus and Return Mice
steps.instruction: Return animals to cages and sanitize the equipment between test subjects.

substeps.instruction: Return the test mouse to its home cage.
Thoroughly clean all chambers, walls, and floor with 50% ethanol.
Allow ethanol to fully evaporate before the next test animal.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Calculate social preference and novelty indices and perform statistical comparisons between genotypes.

substeps.instruction: For social preference trial: calculate time in S1 sniffing zone vs E sniffing zone per animal.
Calculate Social preference index: (S1 zone time) / (S1 + E zone time).
For social novelty trial: calculate time in S2 sniffing zone vs S1 sniffing zone.
Compare indices and raw zone times between genotypes using appropriate statistical tests.
